newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX ends off, seen in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX ends off, seen in narrow range.

text.p: Austrian shares ended softer on Tuesday after a subdued session and traders forecast the ATX would remain rangebound between 1,380 and 1,410 on slim volumes ahead of Friday's expiry of futures and options.
Traders said a EVN's recovery from recent losses helped the index off the day's low of 1,383.75.
"EVN's reversal of the intraday low pushed the market up," said one.
Another predicted the market would head lower next week.
"Next week I expect the market to go down because there are signs of crisis on the interest rate side," he said.
The ATX ended 3.76 points or 0.27 percent lower at 1,390.14. Among its constituents 15 losers outweighed six gainers.
The top gainer was regional electricity utility EVN, climbing 1.36 percent to 1,565 schillings.
The top loser was papermaker Leykam, dropping 1.72 percent to 343 schillings.
The July ATX future fell 10.4 points to 1,391.6.
